parkEditorAccess.title: Park data editor access
parkEditorAccess.description: Create a token for this Codex session. Your browser will encrypt it before you copy it.
parkEditorAccess.keyHelp: Paste the complete public key received in this conversation.
parkEditorAccess.packageHelp: Copy this package into the conversation. Never share your password or the raw token.
parkEditorAccess.invalidKey: The public key is invalid or encryption is unavailable. No token was created.
parkEditorAccess.createFailed: Token creation failed. Check your connection and try again.
parkEditorAccess.revokeFailed: Encryption failed and the token could not be revoked. Revoke it from token management.
parkEditorAccess.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the package manually.
